purpose: Evidence-separated inventory of post-2023 web-agent and web-testing benchmarks that inform PSS-WebTest task design, harness design, or oracle design.

references.paper_or_report: WebArena: A Realistic Web Environment for Building Autonomous Agents
references.reported_scale: 812 tasks across four self-hosted web applications (official ecosystem listings)
not_directly_reusable: not a three-arm CUA-versus-locator software-testing study
does not supply our fault/evolution repair matrix

references.paper_or_report: The BrowserGym Ecosystem for Web Agent Research
references.reported_scale: ecosystem integrates WebArena, VisualWebArena, WorkArena, WebArena-Verified and other benchmark packages
not_directly_reusable: generic web-agent environment rather than a testing oracle study
additional setup and benchmark-specific licenses must be audited

references.paper_or_report: VisualWebArena: Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Realistic Visual Web Tasks
references.reported_scale: 910 visually grounded tasks in the official BrowserGym ecosystem listing
not_directly_reusable: visual task success is not equivalent to software test validity
no matched locator baseline in our intended protocol

references.paper_or_report: WorkArena++: Towards Compositional Planning and Reasoning-based Common Knowledge Work Tasks
references.reported_scale: official repository describes WorkArena levels and a gated ServiceNow instance distribution
not_directly_reusable: enterprise-task correctness is not our persisted-state test oracle

references.reported_scale: 300 tasks across 136 websites according to the official repository
not_directly_reusable: live sites are not deterministic local SUTs
website drift and CAPTCHA make our reset/oracle gate harder to satisfy

references.paper_or_report: WebBench: AI Web Browsing Agent Benchmark
references.reported_scale: official site reports 5,750 tasks across 452 websites
not_directly_reusable: live-site evaluation is not a resettable fault-injection environment
task oracle and website availability require separate audit

references.paper_or_report: WebTestBench: Evaluating Computer-Use Agents towards End-to-End Automated Web Testing
references.reported_scale: paper/repository must be audited for exact task, fault and oracle counts before reuse
reusable_design: directly relevant end-to-end web-testing task framing
not_directly_reusable: must not be described as independent precedent without a full method comparison

references.paper_or_report: WebTestPilot: Agentic End-to-End Web Testing against Natural Language Specification by Inferring Oracles with Symbolized GUI Elements
references.reported_scale: bug-injected web-app benchmark; exact task and fault counts require repository audit
not_directly_reusable: our repository uses it as an SUT bundle/reference, not as an experimental baseline
symbolized GUI elements and our screenshot-only arm are different observation contracts
references.pss_role: direct-neighbor collision boundary and SUT source
